parameters.execution_and_cost: main: decision at close t, fill at close t+1 (MOC), position earns close t+1 -> close t+2 onward; cost per traded name = |dw| x (costs.half_spread_bp(prior close, dollar_adv_21, vol_21, year, 'close') + impact_bp at E = $1M + 0.5 bp fees), missing inputs 40 bp; borrow 25 bp a year on short notional; variant MOO (fill at open t+1, 'open' snapshot) for kappa 1 and the best kappa only

parameters.speed_grid: weights w* = (score - bucket mean) industry-demeaned and scaled to gross 2; GP partial trade w_t = (1 - kappa) w_(t-1) + kappa w*_t for kappa in {1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05}; full rebalance every 5 or 21 sessions reported as the median over all offsets
parameters.target_return: single-session stock return beta-hedged with panel beta_252_spy at t (NaN -> 1, clipped -0.5..3) and demeaned within (date, ind_code); close-to-close for lags j = 1..22 after the signal close t, lag 1 also split into overnight (close t -> open t+1) and intraday (open t+1 -> close t+1); no delisting return (names drop out, counted)
parameters.universe: U3000 members at the signal date t (signals store rows); buckets by panel adv_rank at t: L1 <= 500, L2 501-1000, L3 1001-3000, L12 <= 1000 (primary decision bucket); shorts limited to the easy-to-borrow proxy borrow.short_eligible (rule v1), short leg rescaled to the long leg's gross
